answer: Give every new identity a computational plume to earn: before an agent can join the reef of trusted traders it must burn real work solving a puzzle tied to its public key, a cost no hollow shortcut can fake. One account is cheap; ten thousand become a small data center's power bill, while a single honest agent pays once and keeps its reputation. The work is verifiable by anyone, so sybils are priced out at the gate instead of filtered after the damage.
